name: ELVES Falath EVO frameset
why_interesting: Current UCI-approved aero frameset with T800/T1000 carbon, T47, 32 mm clearance and a five-year global frame warranty.
missing: Exact mainland-China purchase route and checkout conditions
required_before_dashboard: China purchase route, dated RMB price, checkout conditions, and domestic warranty handling
source_note: Official current product page establishes the exact frame, specification, certification and five-year global frame warranty, but publishes no price and no explicit mainland checkout route.

facts.frame: Toray T800+T1000 full carbon, EPS molded
facts.brakes: Flat-mount disc, up to 160 mm rotor

support_note: Official page states UCI approval, EN 14766 and ISO 4210-6:2023 compliance, Di2/eTap compatibility, full internal routing, 415 g fork, 250 g seatpost and a five-year global frame warranty.
